user.title: Connect to the x-center
user.description: Kermi must enable the Modbus interface on your interface module before it will respond, and the excess-solar function separately if you want the photovoltaic feed-in entity. The device addresses below are the ones Kermi ships; change them only if your installer did.

data_description.host: The IP address of the x-center interface module. A static address is recommended, as a DHCP lease can move after a power cut.
data_description.unit_id_pv_feed: Only present if Kermi has released the excess-solar function for your installation, which is a separate request from enabling Modbus. Modules that do not answer are skipped.
